arxiv-1709-03490.title: Measurement of τ \tau polarisation in Z / γ ∗ → τ ​ τ Z/\gamma^{*}\rightarrow\tau\tau decays in proton–proton collisions at s = 8 \sqrt{s}=8 TeV with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-1709-03490.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-1709-03490.description: Abstract This paper presents a measurement of the polarisation of τ \tau leptons produced in Z / γ ∗ → τ ​ τ Z/\gamma^{*}\rightarrow\tau\tau decays which is performed with a dataset of proton–proton collisions at s = 8 \sqrt{s}=8 TeV, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 20.2 fb -1 recorded with the ATLAS detector at the LHC in 2012.

arxiv-2011-13403.title: Optically-induced frequency up-conversion of the ferromagnetic resonance in an ultrathin garnet
arxiv-2011-13403.creator: Lucile Soumah, Davide Bossini, Abdelmadjid Anane, Stefano Bonetti
arxiv-2011-13403.description: Abstract We perform ultrafast pump-probe measurements on a nanometer-thick crystalline Bi-doped yttrium iron garnet film with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy. Tuning the photon energy of the pump laser pulses above and below the material’s bandgap, we trigger ultrafast optical and spin dynamics via both one- and two-photon absorption.

arxiv-2310-00940.title: 1-planar unit distance graphs
arxiv-2310-00940.creator: Panna Gehér, Géza Tóth
arxiv-2310-00940.description: Abstract A matchstick graph is a plane graph with edges drawn as unit distance line segments. This class of graphs was introduced by Harborth who conjectured that a matchstick graph on n n vertices can have at most ⌊ 3 ​ n − 12 ​ n − 3 ⌋ \lfloor 3n-\sqrt{12n-3}\rfloor edges.

arxiv-2310-13690.title: Planet Gap-opening Feedback on Disk Thermal Structure and Composition 2022 Planet Gap-opening Feedback on Disk Thermal Structure and Composition – D
arxiv-2310-13690.creator: Kan Chen, Mihkel Kama, Paola Pinilla, Luke Keyte
arxiv-2310-13690.description: Abstract (Exo-)planets inherit their budget of chemical elements from a protoplanetary disk. The disk temperature determines the phase of each chemical species, which sets the composition of solids and gas available for planet formation. We investigate how gap structures, which are widely seen by recent disk observations, alter the thermal and chemical structure of a disk.

arxiv-2406-17249.title: SlideSLAM: Sparse, Lightweight, Decentralized Metric-Semantic SLAM for Multi-Robot Navigation Thanks: * Equal contribution. † Corresponding author. Thanks: Manuscript received January 9, 2025; revised May 1, 2025; accepted September 2, 2025. This article was recommended for publication by Editor Jav
arxiv-2406-17249.creator: Xu Liu* †, Jiuzhou Lei*, Ankit Prabhu*, Yuezhan Tao, Igor Spasojevic
arxiv-2406-17249.description: Abstract This paper develops a real-time decentralized metric-semantic SLAM algorithm that enables a heterogeneous robot team to collaboratively construct object-based metric-semantic maps. The proposed framework integrates a data-driven front-end for instance segmentation from either RGBD cameras or LiDARs and a custom back-end for optimizing robot trajectories and object landmarks in the map.

arxiv-2407-10375.title: Axisymmetric displacement flows in fluid-driven fractures
arxiv-2407-10375.creator: Sri Savya Tanikella, Emilie Dressaire1. University of California Santa Barbara
arxiv-2407-10375.description: Abstract Displacement flows are common in hydraulic fracturing, as fracking fluids of different composition are injected sequentially in the fracture. The injection of an immiscible fluid at the center of a liquid-filled fracture results in the growth of the fracture and the outward displacement of the interface between the two liquids.

arxiv-2407-19909.title: Substantial Risk of 21 st Century AMOC Tipping even under Moderate Climate Change
arxiv-2407-19909.creator: René M. van Westen, Elian Y.P. Vanderborght, Michael Kliphuis, Henk A. Dijkstra
arxiv-2407-19909.description: Abstract The Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) is a key component of the climate system and considered to be a tipping element. There is still a large uncertainty on the critical global warming level at which the AMOC will start to collapse.

arxiv-2409-01685.title: Optimizing Mortality Prediction for ICU Heart Failure Patients: Leveraging XGBoost and Advanced Machine Learning with the MIMIC-III Database
arxiv-2409-01685.creator: Negin Ashrafi, Armin Abdollahi, Jiahong Zhang, Maryam Pishgar
arxiv-2409-01685.description: Abstract Heart failure affects millions of people worldwide, significantly reducing quality of life and leading to high mortality rates. Despite extensive research, the relationship between heart failure and mortality rates among ICU patients is not fully understood, indicating the need for more accurate prediction models.

arxiv-2410-00525.title: Improving sampling by modifying the effective diffusion
arxiv-2410-00525.creator: T. Lelièvre, R. Santet, G. Stoltz 1: CERMICS, ENPC, Institut Polytechnique de Paris, Marne-la-Vallée, France2: MATHERIALS project-team, Inria, Paris, France
arxiv-2410-00525.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by T. Lelièvre, R. Santet, G. Stoltz 1: CERMICS, ENPC, Institut Polytechnique de Paris, Marne-la-Vallée, France2: MATHERIALS project-team, Inria, Paris, France. Markov chain Monte Carlo samplers based on discretizations of (overdamped) Langevin dynamics are commonly used in the Bayesian inference and computational statistical physics literature to estimate high-dimensional integrals. One can introduce a non-constant diffusion matrix to precondition these dynamics, and recent works have optimized it in order to improve the rate of convergence to stationarity by overcoming entropic and energy barriers.

arxiv-2412-16393.title: A Comprehensive Study of the Dust Declines in R Coronae Borealis Stars 2024 A Comprehensive Study of the Dust Declines in R Coronae Borealis Stars – References
arxiv-2412-16393.creator: Courtney L. Crawford, Jamie Soon, Geoffrey C. Clayton, Patrick Tisserand, Timothy R. Bedding, Caleb J. Clark, Chung-Uk Lee
arxiv-2412-16393.description: Abstract The R Coronae Borealis (RCB) variables are rare, hydrogen-deficient, carbon-rich supergiants known for large, erratic declines in brightness due to dust formation. Recently, the number of known RCB stars in the Milky Way and Magellanic Clouds has increased from ∼ \sim 30 to 162.

arxiv-2505-11003.title: ForensicHub: A Unified Benchmark & Codebase for All-Domain Fake Image Detection and Localization
arxiv-2505-11003.creator: Bo Du 1† , Xuekang Zhu 1,2† , Xiaochen Ma 3,4† , Chenfan Qu 5, 2† , Kaiwen Feng 1† , Zhe Yang 1 , Chi-Man Pun 6 , Jian Liu 2‡ , Jizhe Zhou 1‡
arxiv-2505-11003.description: Abstract The field of Fake Image Detection and Localization ( FIDL ) is highly fragmented, encompassing four domains: deepfake detection (Deepfake), image manipulation detection and localization (IMDL), artificial intelligence-generated image detection (AIGC), and document image manipulation localization (Doc). Although individual benchmarks exist in some domains, a unified benchmark for all domains in FIDL remains blank.

pmc-10736243.title: MIXED-METHODS EVALUATION OF A NOVEL MULTIMODAL COGNITIVE TRAINING “COGMUSE” IN OLDER ADULTS WITH INSOMNIA
pmc-10736243.creator: Ashley Curtis, Amy Costa, Madison Musich, Chloe Rzeppa, Kevin Zemon, Isaac Schroeder, Charles Sielert, Fang Wang
pmc-10736243.description: Lack of pharmacological agents to improve cognition has prompted research on behavioral interventions, such as cognitive training (CT). CT benefit is inconsistent across non-patient populations. However, our recent work reveals multimodal commercialized CT shows promise for improving cognition and sleep in older adults with insomnia. Evaluation of non-commercialized CT allows for easy implementation of test scenarios/variables, monitoring and iterative optimization.

pmc-12597718.creator: Devendra Pratap Singh, Alok Tripathi, Ankita Paul, Saurabh Kumar Kaushal, Megha Dixit, Divya Singh
pmc-12597718.description: IntroductionAging is a complex biological phenomenon that drives the progression of numerous chronic conditions, including osteoporosis, which is characterized by bone loss and increased risk of fragility fractures. The study of microRNA (miRNA) functions has provided valuable insights into the mechanisms that regulate aging and the senescence process.

pmc-12610714.title: Breath Isoprene Sensor Based on Quartz-Enhanced Photoacoustic Spectroscopy
pmc-12610714.creator: Fadia Abou Naoum, Diba Ayache, Tarek Seoudi, Daniel Andres Diaz-Thomas, Alexei Baranov, Fanny Pages, Julien Charensol, Eric Rosenkrantz, Meryem Aouadi, Michael Bahriz, Fares Gouzi, Aurore Vicet, Enza Panzardi
pmc-12610714.description: Isoprene, the most abundant endogenous hydrocarbon in human breath, is a promising biomarker for metabolic and cardiovascular diseases. In this paper, we present the detection of isoprene in exhaled breath using the off-beam Quartz-Enhanced Photoacoustic Spectroscopy (QEPAS) method. The sensor employs a homemade quantum cascade laser emitting at 11.03 μm.

pmc-13111036.title: Unveiling the non-linear synergistic effects of smoking and aging on cataract-AMD comorbidity: an explainable artificial intelligence approach
pmc-13111036.creator: Mingxia Tang, Yu Liu, Lili Dong
pmc-13111036.description: BackgroundThe comorbidity of cataract and age-related macular degeneration (AMD) poses a significant public health burden. Traditional linear statistical models often fail to capture complex, non-linear interactions among risk factors. This study aimed to develop an interpretable machine learning framework to predict comorbidity risk and elucidate the synergistic effects of systemic and ocular factors.

pmc-13233820.title: Recruitment of Mre11 to recombination sites during meiosis
pmc-13233820.creator: Priyanka Priyadarshini, Mahesh Survi, Wael El Yazidi Mouloud, Regina Bohn, Steven Ballet, Neil Hunter, Alexander N Volkov, Corentin Claeys Bouuaert
pmc-13233820.description: The Mre11 nuclease is part of the conserved MRX complex involved in DNA double-strand break (DSB) repair. During meiosis in budding yeast, MRX is also required for Spo11-mediated programmed DSB formation to initiate homologous recombination. Recruitment of Mre11 to meiotic DSB sites depends on Rec114-Mei4 and Mer2, proposed to organize the DSB machinery via biomolecular condensation.

pmc-13342333.title: Preexisting IgG forms immune complexes and links local thermal reactogenicity with immunogenicity in influenza vaccination
pmc-13342333.creator: Julia R Hirsiger, Silke Scarascia, Mike Recher, Glenn Bantug, Christoph T Berger
pmc-13342333.description: Pre-existing pathogen-specific antibodies shape vaccine outcomes, yet their impact on local reactogenicity and qualitative features of the immune response are not fully defined. In this prospective human cohort receiving seasonal influenza vaccination, high baseline hemagglutinin-specific IgG1 levels were associated with more pronounced local thermal responses at the vaccinated arm and greater vaccine-induced antibody levels.
